=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_validate_workflow_validate_bootstrap.py:161-199
  Line or code reference: `with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:` and `python_shim.chmod(0o755)`
  Problem: The regression test creates its Python shim under `tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()` (which defaults to `/tmp`) and chmods the shim to 0o755. On hosted runners where `/tmp` is mounted `noexec`, the shim cannot execute regardless of its mode bits, so the test will fail before any assertion runs.
  Why it fails at runtime: GitHub-hosted Linux runners occasionally mount `/tmp` as `noexec` (and the editor's own diff message in the PR comment confirms this happened on a previous run). When that happens, `bash` will refuse to execute the shim, returning a non-zero exit, and the assertion at line 214 fails.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
